test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six friends, Abhishek, Apurva, Parth, Kiran, Onkar and Viraj, are sitting on the vertices of a regular hexagon and they are sitting facing the centre of the hexagon.

1. Apurva is sitting between Onkar and Parth.

2. Abhishek is sitting next to Onkar.

3. Kiran is not exactly opposite to Apurva. 

In the above question, if Viraj and Onkar exchanged their positions, then who would be sitting next to Kiran?
solution: Case 1: **1) **Apurva is sitting between Onkar and Parth. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddb02c82a2657bc3f77474482e2aeb2ab7ef8668a6e047746f36e90d0c9e7cca.png] 2) Abhishek is sitting next to Onkar. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/021241dd62f98335cb45f05cc59e0a465bdab384071e9de895ee9050628a23fa.png] 3) Kiran is not exactly opposite to Apurva.
